name: Hotel Chais Monnet & Spa
insider_take: This luxurious retreat occupies a masterfully restored 19th-century cognac warehouse, where copper stills once distilled liquid gold in the heart of France's most prestigious spirits region.
whats_special: The hotel sits within authentic stone chai (cognac aging warehouses) that housed Hennessy's precious barrels for over a century. The property features an award-winning spa built around an ancient well, and guests can explore cognac cellars dating back to 1765 just steps from their room.
pro_tip: Book the cognac blending workshop in the hotel's private cellar – you'll create your own personalized bottle using eaux-de-vie aged in the same walls where you're staying.
dont_miss: The evening "Angels' Share" experience on the rooftop terrace, where you can watch the cognac vapors evaporate into the sunset sky – a daily ritual that's been happening in Cognac for centuries. The nearby Charente River offers peaceful boat tours through vineyards that supply the world's finest cognac houses.
pros: Historic cognac distillery converted into luxury hotel
Prime location in the heart of Cognac region
Unique industrial-chic design with preserved distillery elements
cons: Limited dining options in immediate vicinity
Industrial setting may not appeal to all travelers
